utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the school gym after pickup on Friday noted—do you know of any other drop-off spots or times I should track?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s the main one I have for now, but I’ll check with a few neighbors and send over any other spots or times I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep the school gym after pickup on Friday as the main stop for now. Send me any extra spots or times you confirm, and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it second-hand, so I’m waiting on the confirmed details before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair — I’ll confirm the details and send them your way as soon as I have them. I’d love to have you join once it’s set!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — send them over when you have the confirmed details, and I’ll help spread the word. I’d be happy to join once it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies for the repair drive now—Oren may bring screws, tape, and an extension cord, and I’ll add whatever else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I can still bring a few basic tools and help sort whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be perfect, Rey—basic tools and sorting help will keep things moving. I’ll set aside a spot for your tools when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I still need to double-check with a couple parents, but after pickup still sounds like the best window. If you want, I can swing by with whatever screws or tape I can find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — after pickup sounds possible, but let’s wait until you’ve confirmed with the parents and we know which repairs we’re prioritizing before you gather supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, good thinking, Hana — I’ll check with those parents first and hold off on rummaging for supplies until you know the priority repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—right after pickup around 3:30 to 5 sounds best, and I’ll wait on finalizing until you’ve checked with a few other parents.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check the confirmed list and date with the others, then I’ll let you know. Thanks for waiting on me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — I’ll hold off on locking the sign-up sheet until you confirm the list and date with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, it’s going well so far — if you want to help, I could always use extra hands or a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few basic tools — maybe we should start with the lamps and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds perfect, Uli — bring those basic tools and we’ll set up a table for lamps and small appliances first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m going to check the bulletin when I’m back inside and maybe call the organizer for the latest update. If I hear anything new, I’ll spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — let me know what they say about the time, drop-off, and who’s coordinating it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check the bulletin and call the organizer when I’m back inside, then let you know the time, drop-off, and who’s coordinating it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still don’t have any new details, Vik. Best bet is to check the bulletin or call the organizer so you’ve got the latest plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll check the bulletin or call the organizer before I pass anything along. I want to keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the right way to do it, Vik. Once you’ve got the confirmed time and tool list, I’m happy to help spread the word clearly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can bring my drill and hammer, and help with whatever repair needs doing. What should I come by with?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s perfect — a drill and hammer would be a big help. If you can come by Saturday morning at the community room, that’d be wonderful, and we’re still especially short on screwdrivers, pliers, and a decent socket set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning at the community room works for me. I’ll bring the drill and hammer, and I’ll see if I can rustle up screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the time, drop-off spot, and who’s coordinating before we tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Pia — once you’ve confirmed those details, can you send them to me directly so I know we’re sharing the same information?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I will — I’ll check those details and send you the confirmed info directly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I can jump in sorting the tools or setting up the donation table. Just point me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—please set up the donation table first, then help sort the tools if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: You got it — I’ll get the donation table set up now, then circle back to the tools if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks — sorting the donations will help a lot. If you finish that, just come wave me over and I’ll point you to the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll sort these and wave you over when I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll be nearby checking the tool table, so just flag me when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, Dane. I’d check the bulletin or call the organizer so we can get the latest plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good idea — I’ll check the bulletin now and call the organizer if it’s not posted, then I’ll jump wherever they need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane. Let me know what you find, and I’ll come by if they need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds like a good window, thanks — after pickup on Friday should work well. If you hear anything different from the other parents, let me know and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — Friday after pickup is what I’ve got, and I’ll ping you if any parent says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep the school gym plan and sign-up sheet ready for Friday after pickup unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, can you bring an extension cord and a few trash bags? If you can come early, help me set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Leo — I’ll bring the extension cord and trash bags, and I can come early to help set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Gus. Come by about 30 minutes early and we’ll get the tables set first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Sam — lamps and small appliances seem to be the first priority, so if you can bring a basic toolkit and help with those, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Rosa — I’ll bring my basic toolkit and help with the lamps and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help plan it, can you confirm what needs repairing and when the drive is?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly lamps and small appliances, from what folks have told me. I don’t think the time’s fixed yet—Rosa’s still helping sort the setup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — that helps. I’ll wait to hear the confirmed time from Rosa before we start matching supplies or volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, thanks again for pitching in with supplies—I’m letting folks know you’ll be there, and I’m trying to round up a few more neighbors too!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll sort through what I’ve got and bring the useful stuff, and Oren may come by with screws, tape, an extension cord, or at least an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Cleo—please thank Oren for me, and I’ll tell folks we may have extra supplies and helping hands coming.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — where should I start sorting, and is there a label system you want me to use?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Start in the community room, and please label items by type and condition so we can sort them quickly. I still want the exact drop-off time and a named coordinator before we tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll start in the community room and label by type and condition. Pia, are we using your Saturday 10 to 2 suggestion, and is Rey the coordinator on the flyer?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’m checking the bulletin when I’m back inside and I’ll spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the drop-off time and location once you check? I just want to make sure we’re telling people the right thing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check the bulletin and, if it’s still unclear, call the organizer, then I’ll pass along the confirmed time and location.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still waiting on someone organizing it to confirm the time and tools before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally — I’m confirming the time and tools now, and I’ll send you the quick update as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Jules — once you send the confirmed time and tools, I’ll repeat just that update to everyone so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Tess, yes—the repair drive. I promised I’d dig up screws, tape, and maybe an extension cord, and I’m also checking with a couple parents about whether 3:30 to 5 works best.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Oren — screws, tape, and an extension cord would be a big help. I’ll tell folks we’re narrowing down the time and see who else can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — I’ll keep checking with the parents and let you know what I hear. If I find the tools, I’ll bring those by too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rey, Noah’s going to start sorting donations, and I told him we may pull him to the tool table after—can you help me check what tools are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes — I can help check what’s still missing. I’ll look for the basic tools first and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — start with screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures, and I’ll compare your list with the sign-up sheet while Noah sorts donations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know the next repair drive location or time, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the confirmed time or location yet, Opal—Rosa said she’d send me the details today, so I’d rather wait on that before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—please send me Rosa’s confirmed details as soon as you get them, and I’ll hold off marking anything down until then.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
